purpose: The checklist an agent walks before writing an extension. Every row is derived from a specific incident in the four guides, so a score is a claim about which failures the extension can still suffer, not a style opinion.

grading.rule: Never a number out of ten.

claim_state_note: The three efforts' grades below are REPORTED from the guides' own claims, not computed by re-reading source (gaps G2, G5 in the brief pack). The recorder's source lives in a separate vault this site does not have access to.

sections.title: Does it stay safe to leave running?

checks.check: Never originates a request
checks.why: Every fact in the dataset is something the target volunteered to a real user in a real session

checks.check: Never blocks, delays or alters a response
checks.why: A recorder that alters a response can break the page it is watching and you will spend a day thinking the target changed

checks.check: Every hook wrapped in try/catch; never throws into the page
checks.why: An exception in a wrapper is a bug in the target's app, from the target's point of view

checks.check: Never transmits; export is a manual download
checks.why: The invariant that makes the tool defensible

checks.check: A deny list that is a privacy floor, re-derived per transport
checks.why: Message content never captured in any mode, including all

sections.title: Can it prove what it saw?

checks.check: Build version stamped into every artefact
checks.why: Ten days lost to a browser running an old build; a quiet week on the target

checks.check: Running build shown in the UI, on the surface opened first, and coloured when stale
checks.why: The badge shipped to the side panel while the popup went on saying nothing for two versions — exactly the wrong way round

checks.check: Coverage reported per surface, including zeroes
checks.why: A surface absent reads as 'nothing happened'. A surface listed with zero reads as 'we never looked'

checks.check: Truncation flagged, with the original length stored
checks.why: A record that says truncated: true with 4 MiB of content is a fact you can act on. A dropped record is silence

checks.check: Skips counted by endpoint in an unparsed tally
checks.why: That tally is the to-do list for the next parser

checks.check: An observations log recording what was refused, and why
checks.why: Twice settled questions nothing else could, including proving an old build was running

sections.title: Does it fail in the right direction?

checks.check: Missing is null; never 0, '' or {}
checks.why: res || {} turned 'no answer' into 'an answer with nothing in it' and cost two runs

checks.check: No file constructed from an unchecked value
checks.why: new Blob([undefined]) writes the word 'undefined' and calls it undefined.json

checks.check: Records with no stable identifier yield nothing, never the previous id
checks.why: Losing two is correct; mislabelling two is not

checks.check: Bulk data never crosses a size-limited channel
checks.why: 113 MB export vs chrome.runtime.sendMessage; the fix is to remove the boundary, not widen it

checks.check: A circuit breaker over live counters, with generous thresholds
checks.why: Three runs lost silently; a breaker that trips on noise gets ignored, and an ignored breaker is worse than none

checks.check: Failures loud at mechanisms, quiet at data
checks.why: Quiet-and-counted for what you did not understand; loud-and-stop for what did not work

sections.title: Is the evidence separable from the interpretation?

checks.check: Phase 0 first — a recorder with no parsers
checks.why: 'This is not the product.' The best decision in the project

checks.check: captures/ read-only; everything else regenerable
checks.why: Being wrong costs a re-derive, not a re-capture

checks.check: Derived format versioned, and refused when unknown
checks.why: Silently reading a v1 file understates the dataset without saying so

checks.check: Code and data in separate stores, with a per-folder publication rule
checks.why: Different sensitivity, lifecycle, size and failure mode

checks.check: Exports split full / skeleton / debug, with a redaction verifier
checks.why: The verifier counts what it checked, so '0 leaks' means something

sections.title: Is it built on evidence rather than one example?

checks.check: A shape survey written before the parser
checks.why: Found 58 distinct type names in one run and answered a week-old question

checks.check: Routing on what the response says about itself
checks.why: Request-side ids are the caller's opinion; three result sets shared a path and a prefix

checks.check: Derived facts verified against an artefact the system produced
checks.why: Two independent clocks agreeing to within a round trip is strong. One clock agreeing with itself is nothing

checks.check: Structural markers read instead of rendered English
checks.why: Parsing the sentence works until the string is localised, pluralised, or A/B tested

checks.check: Types in structured identifiers read as data, with branching
checks.why: A variant means loosen; a different type means branch

checks.check: Sample caps checked for selecting against the evidence
checks.why: 59 of 70 whole — because the whole ones were the small ones

checks.check: Timestamp provenance labelled (urn vs captured)
checks.why: Lets consumers filter on evidence quality

sections.title: Do the tests pin the lessons?

checks.check: Test files auto-discovered; exits non-zero on zero found
checks.why: 'No tests found' and 'all tests passed' must never look the same

checks.check: Optional-dependency suites print SKIPPED loudly
checks.why: A suite silently dropping 11 tests will eventually be why a bug ships

checks.check: Test names state decisions, not behaviours
checks.why: The label goes with the value; tells the next reader why the code looks that way

checks.check: Fixtures hand-authored and synthetic; real captures never become test data
checks.why: A privacy rule that turned out to be a design rule

checks.check: A real browser drives anything with a real browser boundary
checks.why: The 113 MB messaging bug was invisible to unit tests by construction

graded_efforts.name: The recorder
graded_efforts.grade_note: Reported from what the four guides claim about it — every check above describes behaviour the guides attribute to this tool. Not independently verified against its source (gap G2/G5).
